specification.text: Will the New England Patriots be the official winner of Super Bowl LXI, the championship game for the 2026 NFL season?
specification.yes: The NFL's official final result names the New England Patriots as winner of Super Bowl LXI.
specification.no: The NFL's official final result names another team as winner of Super Bowl LXI.
specification.void: No official winner is declared by 2027-03-31T23:59:59Z, including cancellation or an unresolved final-result dispute.
specification.rescheduling: Follow the named championship if rescheduled within the resolution deadline.

b_prior.rationale: Exactly one of 32 teams is champion if the competition completes. Before considering relative strength, equal weighting supplies a transparent baseline; team exchangeability is a simplifying assumption.
